class.name: GameDefinition
class.brief_description: Authored scenes and rules shared by the Inspector and the fluent Crimson game setup.

method.name: boot
method.description: Creates a configured GameRuntime and attaches it to a live owner on the main thread. Returns null and reports a [code][Crimson][/code] diagnostic if attachment fails or the tree retires the owner or child during attachment.

members.member: Stable identifier stored in this game's checkpoints. Choose a project-specific value before publishing saves.
Capacity, UDP port, and late-join policy for Host Game and Join Game. Leave empty for a game that starts locally.
The player actor instantiated for each participant in a quick game. Use a Node3D root and author optional camera and local visibility references inside this scene.
Directory used for checkpoints in coordinated games. Use a path under user:// so the exported game can write to it.
Positive version number of the coordinated game's checkpoint schema. Update it when the persisted data format changes.
Optional factories for this game's session and scene loader. Set before the game enters the scene tree. Leave empty to use Crimson's native defaults.
Stable identifier of the starting world. In coordinated games this is a key in Worlds. Quick games pair it with Starting World Scene.
The 3D scene mounted by Play Solo, Host Game, and Join Game. Place PlayerSpawnPoint nodes in this scene to supply player placements.
Catalog for coordinated world loading and travel. Each stable world ID maps to a scene_id and a local PackedScene resource path.
